notes: Extracts Appearance & Branding into its own modular React page, continuing the incremental architecture transition away from main.tsx.
Repairs appearance persistence with explicit Saved / Unsaved / Saving / Error state and synchronization from persisted settings.
Restores a reusable media gallery for choosing existing logos and background images, with upload-new support.
Adds built-in appearance presets (ArmoryGrid Default, Dark Armory, Slate, Light, High Contrast) plus Save Current as Preset and delete custom preset.
Separates application identity (name, tagline, logo, background) from color/theme presets so changing themes does not overwrite branding identity.
Adds reusable media service, MediaPicker, ThemePresetPicker and branding utility modules for future pages.
Fixes stale hard-coded version text in Settings > Updates.
